input_structure_path.description: Input PDB or CIF file for RFdiffusion3.

contig.description: Contig map string in v1 slash-separated format, e.g. 'A52-156/0 50-60' for binder design or 'A20-30/10-20/A40-50' for scaffold design. Auto-converted to RFdiffusion3 comma syntax internally.

num_designs.description: Number of backbones to generate per batch (maps to diffusion_batch_size)

hotspot.description: Binding hotspot residues for binder design, including chain ids e.g. A123,A124. Maps to select_hotspots in the RFD3 JSON spec.

dump_trajectories.description: Save RFdiffusion3 trajectory files (large; default: false)

run_parameters.description: Additional CLI arguments for RFdiffusion3 (e.g. 'inference_sampler.step_scale=3 inference_sampler.gamma_0=0.2')

spec_overrides.description: JSON-encoded InputSpec overrides to merge into the generated RFdiffusion3 specification.
